(4) The piano melody swells slightly in complexity while maintaining its slow tempo. The voice remains the focal point, expressing a sense of resignation and quiet sorrow. The overall mix is clean and well-balanced between the voice and the instrument. (5) The final segment features a brief silence in narration where the piano plays a concluding phrase.
